resources.string: Put at least two games on the wheel to spin it.
Spin the wheel to pick the next game.
Play it the way your table does.
That\'s the most house games a wheel holds. Remove one to add another.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_holdem
string-array.item: Two cards each, face down, then five shared cards: three on the flop, then the turn, then the river.
Your best five cards from your two and the five on the board win.
A round of betting before the flop and after each new card.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_omaha
string-array.item: Four cards each, then five shared cards, dealt as in Hold\'em.
You must use exactly two of your cards and exactly three from the board.
Usually played pot-limit.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_omaha_hilo
string-array.item: Omaha, with the pot split between the best high hand and the best low hand.
A low is five different ranks, 8 or under, aces low. Straights and flushes don\'t spoil it.
Two cards from your hand and three from the board for each half. No low: high takes it all.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_big_o
string-array.item: Omaha Hi-Lo with five cards each instead of four.
Still exactly two of your cards and three from the board, for the high and for the low.
The low needs five different ranks, 8 or under. No low: high takes it all.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_stud
string-array.item: No shared cards. Two down and one up each; the lowest card showing opens the betting.
Three more cards face up, one at a time, then the last one face down.
Your best five of your seven win.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_stud_hilo
string-array.item: Seven-card stud, with the pot split between the best high hand and the best low hand.
A low is five different ranks, 8 or under, aces low.
Any five of your seven for the high, any five for the low. No low: high takes it all.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_razz
string-array.item: Seven-card stud played for the lowest hand, which takes the whole pot.
Aces are low. Straights and flushes don\'t count, but pairs hurt.
The best hand is 5-4-3-2-A. The highest card showing opens the betting.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_triple_draw
string-array.item: Five cards each, face down, and three chances to swap some for new ones, with betting each time.
The lowest hand wins. Aces are high, and straights and flushes count against you.
The best hand is 7-5-4-3-2 in mixed suits.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_badugi
string-array.item: Four cards each, face down, and three draws, with betting each time.
Aim for four cards of four different suits and ranks, as low as you can: a badugi. Aces are low.
Any badugi beats any three-card hand. The best is A-2-3-4 in four suits.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_pineapple
string-array.item: Hold\'em, but with three cards each.
Throw one away before the flop comes.
Then it\'s Hold\'em with the two you kept.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_crazy_pineapple
string-array.item: Hold\'em, with three cards each.
Keep all three through the flop, and throw one away when the betting on the flop is done.
Then play the turn and the river with two, as in Hold\'em.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_five_card_draw
string-array.item: Five cards each, face down, and a round of betting.
Swap some for new ones, usually up to three, then bet again.
The best high hand wins.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_short_deck
string-array.item: Hold\'em with the 2s to 5s taken out: 36 cards.
A flush beats a full house. An ace can play low in A-6-7-8-9.
Some tables also put three of a kind above a straight: agree before you deal.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_irish
string-array.item: Four cards each, as in Omaha, and betting before and after the flop.
When the betting on the flop is done, throw two away.
Play the turn and the river as Hold\'em, with the two you kept.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_courchevel
string-array.item: Omaha with five cards each, and the first card of the flop turned up before the first bet.
Two more cards finish the flop, then come the turn and the river.
Exactly two of your cards and three from the board. Often played hi-lo.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_follow_the_queen
string-array.item: Seven-card stud with wild cards. Queens are always wild.
The card dealt face up right after a face-up queen makes its whole rank wild too.
Another face-up queen moves that to the next card. If the last card up is a queen, only queens stay wild.

string-array.name: dealers_rules_high_chicago
string-array.item: Seven-card stud with a split pot.
Half goes to the best hand.
The other half goes to whoever holds the highest spade face down.
